variants.title: Critical current density of an NbTi wire
variants.sample: NbTi multifilament wire at 4.2 K, Tc near 9.5 K (SIMULATED)
variants.method: transport I-V with the 1 uV/cm criterion at 4.2 K, 6 K and 2 T
variants.unknown: critical current density, Jc against T and field
variants.note: A magnet conductor: hundreds of amperes, a very sharp transition (n = 40) and a field scale of a few tesla. Tc of NbTi about 9.5 K; Ic0, B0, n and the cross-section are illustrative.

source.title: Tinkham, Introduction to Superconductivity: NbTi Tc about 9.5 K
